about: Purchase links for the production ticket catalogs: each Attraction Tickets link gets its country store, and the store pages each product lacked are added. One entry per product, written as an admin write body ({ region, slug, links }) for upsert_ticket_product.
apply: Send each entry of `products` as a partial update of that product ({ region, slug, links }, the admin editor's write body narrowed to `links`): `links` replaces the stored list whole, so it is the full list, production's links in production's order with the changes made. `review` says per product what changed and from which catalog version; skip a product whose region's catalog has moved past that version and recompute it.
requires: The API with the link field `store` (wt/ticket-links, PAR-1322). The production API before that refuses `store` with "is not a link field".

source.verified: every added url answered 200 without a redirect, found among the hreflang alternates of the product page production already links
